title: SynOS configuration bundle descriptor (bundle.json)
description: Written at the root of a configuration bundle by any generator (the web configurator, a script, a person). The build tool refuses bundles whose format it does not know or whose engine requirement it does not meet.

format.description: Bundle layout version; 1 is described in docs/BUNDLE.md

manifest.description: The manifest to build, relative to the bundle root

min.description: Oldest build engine (VERSION file) that understands this bundle

name.description: Short name of the configuration (the manifest file name without .yml)

files.description: Optional list of every file in the bundle, for integrity reporting
